title: Support Facility, Chalk River Laboratories
jurisdiction: Chalk River, Ontario; federal site administered by Canadian Nuclear Laboratories
code_edition: 2015 National Building Code of Canada and 2015 National Fire Code; the report states no formal municipal permitting process

facts.text: The report describes a two-storey, 4,800 m² mass-timber maintenance/manufacturing building with welding, paint, carpenter and workshop areas.

It states that the NFC hot-work rule required combustible/flammable materials within 15 m of hot work to be protected against ignition, and describes exposed timber within that radius as a design issue.

The case study describes flame-retardant treatment to ceiling timber and more remote exposed beams/columns, stainless-steel cladding to lower column portions nearer hot work, and noncombustible floor/welding curtains.
The report cites the Support Facility Code Compliance Report B750-20000-REPT-001, Morrison Hershfield (2019), without including it.

limitations: Shares the same CNL source report with the Science Collaboration Centre candidate; the buildings and issues are distinct but not separate source files.
The cited Support Facility Code Compliance Report B750-20000-REPT-001 (Morrison Hershfield, 2019) was not located as a public attachment.
No project drawings, product qualification/test records or final decision instrument were attached.
